name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: Materialize checkboxes with the morphing tick, a filled-in style and an indeterminate state.
improvements: Built on Radix Checkbox: role=checkbox with aria-checked, Space toggles, and a native input is still submitted with forms.
Indeterminate state (aria-checked=mixed) for both the default and filled-in styles.
Visible focus halo for keyboard users, tinted with the secondary color when checked.
Label and description are wired with htmlFor and aria-describedby instead of relying on a sibling span.
Transitions are turned off when the user prefers reduced motion; colors follow dark mode.
